profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Amplitude
profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for web technologies and applications.  I really enjoy creating rich and dynamic UI for end users

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Extended and maintained WMX front end, a platform for advertisers to manage audience extension for multi-channel ads. (React, Node, Express, Ruby on Rails)

Provide day to day operations support for WMX front end platform. (Ansible, Jenkins, One-ops)

Evangelized and implemented use of graphql to speed up development and flexibility.

Implemented a chrome extension in order to provide development across multiple environments, and assist ad operations day to day needs.

Worked hand in hand across multiple site teams to re-implement ads in a full redesign of walmart.com

Converted all placements on walmart.com from programmatic ads to native fluids.

Part of a two engineer team that built out server to server ads fro walmart.com, and responsible for maintaining supporting needed servers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Work with technical, design, business staff to create applications and pages

-Provide learning sessions to assist development team with front end development, providing a deeper insight on nuances of JavaScript

-Researched and prescribed front end build tools such gulp, grunt, webpack 

-Research current industry trends, and assist with development and promotion of coding best practices within team.

-Created coding analytics to assist in the development road map to deprecate legacy UI code

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Strong use of Sencha Ext-JS, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, Web Services, and C# to provide a rich user Interface.

-Actively contributed to UI implementation and UI standards and conventions to improve programming time and maintainability.

-Create and modify features and components for product releases, customers requests and product demonstrations.

-Worked on Autonomy Optimost, a web analytics tool that provides marketing optimization, multivariate testing,  segmentation and targeting. Started with a team to begin on a large scale refactor, to rewrite the project from a hosted solution to a closed box product.

-Working on Autonomy Explore, a multi-channel tool which allows  to review prospects, online sentiments, respond to a customer survey; and evaluate a grouping of especially successful sales calls, emotionally-driven customer service interactions, and notes from a storefront.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
-Extending a Java Swing application designed for employee scheduling and tracking. 

-Implemented feature to enable users to send SMS messages through the application, by programming a GSM modem.

-Fulfilled request to customize application.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas
